Iran Mourns Supreme Leader Khamenei with Funeral Processions

Millions of Iranians have participated in funeral processions for the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, following the arrival of his body in Iraq and subsequent ceremonies in Iran. Reports indicate large crowds gathered for the processions in cities like Najaf and Qom, with some coverage also noting the spread of AI-generated fake images online related to the event. The funeral ceremonies are unfolding over several days.
